packages.title: Packages priced per table of ten

packages.footnote: Meet a venue’s minimum food spend and the hire fee is waived · Book 60 days ahead for a further 5% off

promotions.title: Book on a public holiday and pay less
promotions.desc: Events and food orders on the dates below are discounted straight off the total. The reduction is applied automatically in the quote — no code needed.

promotions.other1: Book 60 days or more ahead: a further 5% off the total.

promotions.other3: Home delivery orders over 500,000 VND: free delivery.
promotions.noStack: Holiday and early-booking offers do not stack; the system applies whichever is higher for you.

menu.title: Country cooking, made by hand and served hot
menu.desc: The menu changes with the season. These prices are for dining at the restaurant; for banquet pricing see Party packages.
menu.searchPlaceholder: Type a dish name, for example: salad, fish, hotpot…

dish.noteTitle: Worth knowing before you order this
dish.byWeightNote: This dish is priced by actual weight, so it cannot be ordered individually online.
dish.bookWithDish: Book an event with this dish

home.heroTitle: Six spaces, six ways to tell a story
home.heroDesc: Riverside garden spaces, country cooking and full event service for twenty to eight hundred guests.
home.spacesDesc: Each area has its own entrance, reception space and service kitchen — your event is never disturbed by another.
home.packagesDesc: The price covers service, table linen, herbal tea and iced tea. Venue hire and VAT are not included.
home.kitchenDesc: Order individual dishes for delivery or to eat in — no full package required.
home.averageScore: An average of {{diem}} out of 5 from guests who have held events here
home.ctaDesc: Tell us your date and how many guests you expect, and our team will build a menu and quote within 24 hours. Viewing the venues in person is free.

spaceDetail.feeNote: Meet the venue minimum food spend and the hire fee is waived. Exact costs are shown at the booking step.

forgot.sentNote: is a registered email address, you will receive a message with a link to reset your password. The link works once and expires after 30 minutes.
forgot.spamNote: If nothing arrives, check your spam folder or contact the restaurant and we will reset it for you.
forgot.intro: Enter the email you registered with and we will send a link to reset your password.

payment.title: Pay for an order
payment.desc: Enter the code you received when booking an event or ordering food to see what is owed and get a transfer code.
payment.settled: This order is fully paid; nothing further is needed.
payment.qrDesc: Open your banking app and scan the code below. The amount and reference are already inside the code, so there is nothing to type.

payment.afterTransfer: Once you have transferred, the restaurant reconciles the payment, usually within working hours. This page changes to "Received" when accounts match your payment against the bank statement.
